Read tables exported from GBE-Bund

Source: R/data-gbe.R
mt_read_gbe.Rd

Parses the CSV export of tables of the Federal Health Monitoring (Gesundheitsberichterstattung des Bundes, https://www.gbe-bund.de): a few title lines, two header lines (for example years and causes of death) and data rows whose first columns hold the row variables (for example region, age and sex), each written only where it changes. The file is Latin-1 encoded with ; as separator.

Usage

mt_read_gbe(
  file,
  row_names = c("region", "age", "sex"),
  col_names = c("year", "cause")
)

Arguments

file

Path of the exported CSV file.

row_names

Names of the row variables, in their order.

col_names

Names of the two column variables (outer, inner).

Value

A data.table with the row and column variables, value and symbol.

Details

Symbols of official statistics are kept in column symbol: "-" (nothing, value 0), "." (unknown or confidential, value NA), "X" (not applicable, value NA), "..." (not yet available, value NA).
